theorems.name: Submission.codim1_rdo_dg_vdl_measure_closedBall_ne_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P) (y v : Euclid P), v ≠ 0 → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => (μ (closedBall y ρ)).toReal⁻¹ • ∫ z in closedBall y ρ, ν z ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 v) → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → μ (closedBall y r) ≠ 0
